task.description:
Write test specs and additional test code for requirement SCH-06 (Timer jitter).

SCH-06 adds configurable random jitter (±N ms) to the scheduler polling interval. BACKEND-DEV has already implemented the feature with 13 inline/dedicated unit tests.

Your task:
1. Write a test spec at tests/specs/SCH-06.md covering all acceptance criteria from the requirement
2. The existing tests in tests/unit/sch06_timer_jitter_test.zig and inline tests in src/scheduler/scheduler.zig already cover:
   - TC-SCH-06-01 through TC-SCH-06-13
   - jitter_0_disabled: jitter_ms=0 → delay = base_interval
   - jitter_nonzero_symmetric: output within [-jitter, +jitter] range
   - jitter_clamped_to_zero: output clamped to ≥0
   - jitter_deterministic_seed: same config + same seed → same output
   - jitter_mean_approximation: mean ~0 over many samples
   - computePollDelayMs boundary tests
3. Add any missing test cases for edge cases not yet covered
4. Validate that zig build test passes

Focus on the test spec document and any missing coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec at tests/specs/SCH-06.md covers all acceptance criteria from SCH-06
All existing unit tests still pass
Any missing edge cases have test coverage added

result.summary: Test spec and additional test cases for SCH-06 (Timer jitter). Created tests/specs/SCH-06.md covering all 5 acceptance criteria. Added 3 new test cases (TC-SCH-06-14 through TC-SCH-06-16) for edge cases: minimum jitter range coverage, independent PRNG seeding, and span verification. All 16 SCH-06 tests pass (9 inline + 7 dedicated).
